as_told.title: Betty Hill describes the exploding object and debris

plain: Clas Svahn, a researcher who collects records about unexplained sightings, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, what a woman named Betty Hill once told him. According to Svahn, Hill said that in the 1950s she was sitting on a porch with a relative when something crossed the sky and crashed, and they went into the field and brought back debris, which the story says ended up buried in her backyard near Portsmouth, New Hampshire. In a recording of Hill herself, she places it on a warm night while visiting family in Maine, and says they first thought the object was a plane, a story that would mean ordinary people once held pieces of a crashed unknown craft.
